name: Pembrolizumab + Platinum + Pemetrexed then Pemetrexed/Pembrolizumab Maintenance (KEYNOTE-189, NSCLC non-squamous)
cyclesNote: Induction: 4 cycles every 21 days of pembrolizumab 200 mg + platinum (carboplatin AUC 5 or cisplatin 75 mg/m2) + pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 Day 1. Maintenance: pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 + pembrolizumab 200 mg every 21 days, to a maximum of 35 total pembrolizumab cycles (DeVita line 70914). Alternative pembrolizumab schedule: 400 mg every 6 weeks.

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.PD_L1: any (benefit shown across all PD-L1 levels, including PD-L1 < 1%)
biomarkers.note: Chemoimmunotherapy for metastatic NON-squamous NSCLC regardless of PD-L1 expression. Pembrolizumab plus pemetrexed plus carboplatin or cisplatin. Trial excluded patients with sensitizing EGFR mutations or ALK rearrangements; oncogene-driven NSCLC is directed to targeted therapy first-line. PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor contraindications (e.g., active autoimmune disease, significant immunosuppression) must be excluded. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, Systemic Therapy for Metastatic Disease (KEYNOTE-189); DeVita 12th ed.

histology: non-squamous (adenocarcinoma, large cell carcinoma, or NSCLC not otherwise specified); NOT for squamous (pemetrexed is restricted to non-squamous histology)

premedications.name: Pemetrexed supplementation
premedications.notes: folic acid and vitamin B12 supplementation plus dexamethasone premedication per pemetrexed labeling.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: carboplatin backbone is moderate emetic risk (cisplatin alternative is high risk); give tier-appropriate prophylaxis.

supportiveCare: immune-related adverse event monitoring for pembrolizumab (thyroid, hepatic, pulmonary/pneumonitis, colitis, endocrinopathies, myocarditis)
pemetrexed: folic acid + vitamin B12 + dexamethasone premedication
carboplatin dosed to target AUC (Calvert formula); antiemetic prophylaxis by platinum emetogenicity
monitoring: immune-related toxicity screen (TSH/free T4, LFTs, glucose, cortisol as indicated) during pembrolizumab
renal function before each cycle (drives carboplatin AUC / cisplatin eligibility)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold pembrolizumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; obtain clinical review before rechallenge.
Review required; hold or reduce chemotherapy per protocol-specific hematologic criteria.

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed. line 70724 (pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks) and line 233347 (flat 200 mg every 3 weeks or 400 mg every 6 weeks). Given Day 1 with the platinum/pemetrexed induction (4 cycles) and continued as maintenance with pemetrexed for up to 35 total cycles (line 70914). Alternative schedule: 400 mg IV every 6 weeks.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Chapter 30: pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks (KEYNOTE-024, line 70724); flat dose 200 mg every 3 weeks or 400 mg every 6 weeks (line 233347)

drugs.name: CARBOplatin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v7.2026, NSCL-F line 4809 (Carboplatin AUC 5 Day 1). Platinum backbone of the induction (cycles 1 to 4). Alternative platinum per KEYNOTE-189: CISplatin 75 mg/m2 Day 1 (NSCL-F line 4810); carboplatin was used in 72% of KEYNOTE-189 patients per NCCN MS-55. Target AUC via Calvert formula (basis auc, unit AUC). ISMP tall-man (CARBOplatin).

drugs.name: Pemetrexed
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v7.2026, NSCL-F line 4809 (Pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 Day 1). Non-squamous only. Given Day 1 in the 4-cycle induction and continued as maintenance with pembrolizumab. Requires folic acid + vitamin B12 supplementation and dexamethasone premedication per pemetrexed labeling.
